identifiers.identifier_scope: Investigational radiopharmaceutical; lutetium-177 labeled NeoB (GRPR-targeting peptide radioligand)

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: A lutetium-177 labeled bombesin/GRPR-targeting peptide that binds gastrin-releasing peptide receptor-expressing tumor cells and delivers beta radiation to those cells.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: Receptor binding to GRPR followed by tumor-localized delivery of beta-particle radiation from lutetium-177, causing DNA damage and radiocytotoxicity.
mechanism_of_action.selectivity: Targeted to GRPR-expressing tissues/tumors via the NeoB peptide ligand.

typical_use.cancer: Solid tumors with GRPR expression, especially gastrointestinal stromal tumor and other GRPR-positive malignancies under investigation
typical_use.scope: Not approved; studied in GRPR-positive advanced/metastatic cancers

data_notes.record_scope: Focused on publicly documented clinical, biological, and pharmacokinetic information for investigational [177Lu]Lu-NeoB. Quantitative fields are null or empty where not firmly established in accessible human sources.
